title: The Fork in the Road
tagline: the first boss - make the program choose
hints: `if (hp < 30) { ... } else if (hp < 70) { ... } else { ... }` - the FIRST matching branch wins and the rest are skipped. That is why order matters.
`==` compares, `=` assigns. `if (hp = 0)` compiles and ruins your day. Comparison is always the doubled one.
`&&` is and, `||` is or. `if (hp < 30 && potions > 0)` means both must be true.
You wrote the status chain already - do the action as a SECOND, separate if/else chain below it. Two questions, two chains.

Order the action chain exactly as the brief lists it: dead first, then low-health cases, then the key, then the fallback. Put the key check first and a dying hero will walk through a door instead of drinking.
